verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public API covering transactions, accounts and statements, budgets and spend limits, expenses and receipt upload, vendors and payments, user listing with filters, referrals/onboarding, and webhooks. Its integration guides also show bulk virtual-card issuance, user creation and limit setting, and an official MCP server for AI assistants. However, nothing claims API parity with the UI: API tokens must be created in the dashboard, and many UI features have no evidenced API counterpart. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or coverage map, API access to approval-flow and policy configuration, travel booking, accounting-integration setup, and AI audit/review agent controls, token provisioning without the dashboard, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
